reviews.reason: The needed identity compares two exact periodic structures through a morphism with zero-action kernel and cokernel; it requires a coordinated choice of lifts and determinant signs, not just multiplicativity in one short exact sequence. reviews.core_assessment: Identify both connecting isomorphismsQ toK and choose compatible admissible sequences for the kernels, images and quotient of the two exact periodic complexes. Compare the determinant-line expressions with the induced quotient automorphism, retaining the permutation signs to obtain the precise multiplicative ratio.
